# sheatz — Two-person software studio

## Overview
sheatz is a small independent software studio that designs, builds, and operates web applications, mobile apps, and on-device AI products. The studio is run by two people with no sales team, account managers, or handover layers.

## Key Pages
- Home: https://sheatz.work/
- Products (software we build and run ourselves): https://sheatz.work/products
- Work (client commissions): https://sheatz.work/work
- Services (what we build and pricing): https://sheatz.work/services
- About (how we work): https://sheatz.work/about
- Contact: https://sheatz.work/contact

## Products
sheatz builds and operates its own software products. Each product is listed with its lifecycle state (planning, in-development, beta, live, paused, retired) so visitors know exactly what is available and what is still in development.

Products are published at: https://sheatz.work/products/[slug]

## Services
Published price ranges for:
- Web applications: £25,000 – £75,000 (fixed scope)
- Mobile apps: £30,000 – £100,000 (fixed scope)
- On-device AI integration: £20,000 – £60,000 (fixed scope)
- Websites: £15,000 – £40,000 (fixed scope)
- Automation: £10,000 – £30,000 (fixed scope)
- Design systems: £15,000 – £35,000 (fixed scope)

All ranges are in GBP. Full details at: https://sheatz.work/services

## Process
Every project follows a written process:
1. Discovery — understand the problem, constraints, and success criteria
2. Specification — written scope, fixed price, timeline
3. Build — working software every week, code reviewed, tested
4. Verify — automated gates, manual review, performance budgets
5. Ship — deploy, monitor, stay on after launch

## Differentiators (Practices)
1. You own the code — every line, every repo, from day one
2. Fixed scope, fixed price — no hourly rates, no surprise invoices
3. Working software weekly — not demos, not Figma files, real code in your hands
4. No sales layer — you talk to the person building it
5. We run what we build — monitoring and fixes after launch are part of the job
6. Written down before we start — scope, price, timeline agreed in writing

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: Astro, TypeScript, vanilla CSS, GSAP
- Backend: Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1 (SQLite), Cloudflare R2
- Email: Resend
- Bot protection: Cloudflare Turnstile (optional)
- Deployment: Cloudflare Pages
- Testing: Vitest, Playwright

## Important Notes
- No client names, testimonials, or case studies are published without explicit permission
- No fabricated metrics, awards, or "trusted by" claims
- All pricing is published as ranges, not hourly rates
- The studio is two people — no team page, no founder bios
- All content is original, no AI-generated filler
